serverstats-desc: Publishes aggregate CPU, memory and worker statistics for the wiki server.
serverstats-summary: Resource usage for the server hosting this wiki, sampled once a minute over the last 24 hours.
serverstats-cpu-subtitle: Cores used, against a limit of $1.
serverstats-memory-subtitle: Megabytes resident, against a limit of $1 MB.
serverstats-workers-subtitle: Busy and idle workers, stacked as the whole pool.
serverstats-updated: Last sample: $1 UTC. Samples are taken once a minute.
serverstats-nodata: No samples have been recorded yet. Statistics appear once the sampler has run for a few minutes.
serverstats-gap: Gaps in the lines are server restarts, where the counters reset.
